removeWhen: When a published @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent release provides projectDir (or a reviewed equivalent the Gateway adopts), dequeues delivered image-only (empty-text) queued messages, normalizes steer and follow-up images as prompts are, keeps transcript-held extension prompt sections in the idle session.systemPrompt (#1312), and ends a run start whose preflightResult("started") callback throws without leaving the session busy (#1340), serializes ModelRuntime config reads so readiness cannot overtake a detached registration refresh (#2199), and preserves explicitly requested pending tool names when a host narrows the restored loadout before MCP registration (#2181), remove the patch as the Gateway README section 'Tron-patched pi-coding-agent' lists, then npm run update:pi-sdk to that release.
